definitions: A person, especially a soldier, sent out to obtain information about the enemy or about an area.
A member of the Scout Association or a similar organization for boys and girls.
A person employed to look for new talent in a particular area, such as sport or music.
A quick or preliminary search for something.
examples: She joined the Scouts when she was ten.
A football scout discovered the young player.
They did a quick scout for berries.
